items.text: Additive manufacturing and 3D printing careers include design for printing, machine operation, materials handling, post-processing, quality inspection and service bureau work, and success depends on understanding materials and tolerances, not only owning a printer.
Learn design for printing and one material family, produce parts that meet a tolerance and document the process.
Verify real part examples and never pay for a placement promise.
